_meta.what_this_is: A token-bucket rate limiter's configuration and the request stream it must police. capacity is the most requests allowed in a burst; refill_per_sec is how fast tokens replenish. requests is a list of arrival times in seconds. The stream is designed to expose the classic bug: an initial burst, then a long idle gap, then a bigger burst -- during the idle a correct bucket saturates at capacity while a buggy one accumulates tokens without bound, so the post-idle burst floods straight through the buggy limiter.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Arrival times are hand-authored so allowed/denied counts and the post-idle burst are exact and checkable. No clock, no server -- time is the timestamps.
_meta.format: capacity; refill_per_sec; requests: list of arrival times (seconds)
